title: Uruguayan Pudding Panna Cotta
description: A creamy and sweet dessert inspired by Uruguayan culture, with an Indian twist.
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle gelatin over 1/4 cup of cold water and let it sit for 5 minutes.
In a medium saucepan, combine pudding, milk, sugar, and cardamom powder. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and add the softened gelatin, stirring until it's fully dissolved.
Add ghee and stir until combined.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight until set.
Garnish with chopped pistachios before serving.
